fnol_text: My name is Leah Gallagher and I live at 191 Juniper Court, Fairview, PA 16468. You can reach me on (555) 731-1283 or leah.gallagher@example.com. Our house was broken into on 5 February 2024. The back door was forced and a laptop, jewellery and a television were taken. Policy HH-2023-00022. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Gallagher on (555) 731-1283 to acknowledge the claim. Leah confirmed the loss date as 5 February 2024.
Site visit to 191 Juniper Court. Neighbour Rafael Pereira was present and confirmed the timeline.
